name: Cloudflare DNS over HTTPS
tagline: Public DoH resolver for privacy-preserving DNS queries over HTTPS.
description: Cloudflare's free public DNS over HTTPS (DoH) resolver at cloudflare-dns.com. Clients send DNS queries as HTTPS requests (RFC 8484 binary wire format or JSON) and receive encrypted responses, avoiding cleartext DNS on the network. No account or API key is required for the public 1.1.1.1 DoH endpoints.

auth.details: No authentication required for the public DoH resolver. Queries are accepted anonymously over HTTPS.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Unlimited free public use of 1.1.1.1 DoH; no paid plans for the public resolver

rate_limits: not published (fair use; abuse may be rate-limited)
use_cases: resolve a hostname to A/AAAA records over HTTPS
look up MX or TXT records without a local resolver
perform DNSSEC-aware lookups from a backend service
test DoH client integration against Cloudflare's public resolver
query DNS from restricted networks where UDP/53 is blocked
